name: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Award for Gallantry
benefit: - Trophy - Citation - Individual Medals (if multiple persons)
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be an Indian seafarer serving on any vessel. 1. The applicant should have performed an act of exceptional bravery in adverse maritime conditions. 1. The applicant’s act should involve saving lives, property, or environment beyond normal duty.
